direction.camera: Guide attention with memphis geometry; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: arrange playful graphic masses around one obvious focal element; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with playful offset; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with clear silhouette.
direction.lighting: flat bright fill; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: painted shapes and printed dots; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around graphic bounce; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use memphis geometry,playful offset,bold dots,color rhythm,graphic bounce,clear silhouette as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
